turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I’d like to make some changes to my upcoming flight from Las Vegas to Houston. Can you help me with that?

Sure, I can help you with that. To get started, could you please provide your user ID and the reservation ID for your Las Vegas to Houston flight? If you don’t know your reservation ID, let me know and I can help you locate it.
Yes, my user ID is james_taylor_7043 and my reservation ID is 1N99U6.

Thank you for providing your user ID and reservation ID. Could you please specify what changes you would like to make to your upcoming flight from Las Vegas to Houston? For example, do you want to change the flight date, time, cabin class, baggage, or passenger information? Let me know the details so I can assist you further.
I’d like to change my current one-stop flight to a nonstop flight from Las Vegas to Houston. Also, I want to remove my checked bag from the reservation and get a refund for it, if possible.

- I can help you change your flights to nonstop options, but the origin, destination, and trip type must remain the same. You will need to use a single gift card or credit card (already in your profile) for any payment or refund difference.
